name: GA-06
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Lucy McBath running with a large financial advantage
Opponent Kevin Martin has raised only about $10,000
Prediction markets price McBath at roughly 96%
model.rationale: The district's strong Democratic lean, McBath's incumbency, and her roughly $676,000 cash advantage against a rival with about $100 on hand point to a lopsided race, and markets agree at about 96% for McBath. A modest haircut from the fundamentals-based margin accounts for the absence of polls and expert ratings.
model.watch: Any late outside spending or polling showing the Republican competitive would be the first sign of movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Lucy McBath, the Democratic incumbent, is heavily favored in this strongly Democratic-leaning suburban Atlanta district. She has raised nearly $900,000 and holds about $676,000 in cash, while Republican Kevin Martin has raised roughly $10,000 with almost nothing banked, leaving him little ability to compete. No independent polls or expert ratings are available for the race, but prediction markets price McBath's chances at about 96 percent.

The fundamentals point to a wide margin, with district lean, the favorable national environment, incumbency, and the money gap all pointing the same direction. The main uncertainty is simply the lack of polling, so the forecast carries moderate uncertainty despite the lopsided picture. Barring unexpected outside intervention, McBath is on track for an easy re-election.
